# Jason Choi Real Estate (최재봉 부동산)

> Jason Choi (최재봉) is a Korean-speaking REALTOR® in Calgary, Alberta, in real estate since 2007. Licensed in Alberta (First Place Realty) and British Columbia (Maple Supreme Realty Inc.). He specializes in business sales (restaurants, gas stations, hotels and motels, liquor stores, car washes, convenience and grocery stores), commercial leasing and investment property, and also helps home buyers and sellers. Service in English and Korean.

## Services
- Business sales and valuations (confidential marketing, off-market / pocket listings)
- Commercial leasing for tenants and landlords
- Investment property (retail plazas, industrial, multi-family, hotels, gas stations)
- Calgary residential specialist since 2007: buying and selling houses, condos, townhomes and new homes in all 8 CREB® districts; Calgary affordability calculator, closing cost calculator and local buyer checklist (hail, radon, legal suites, RPR, flood areas, condo documents, schools) at https://jasonchoirealestate.com/#residential
- Areas: Calgary, Airdrie, Chestermere, Cochrane, Okotoks, Red Deer, Lethbridge and other Alberta communities; British Columbia

## Free guides (PDF)
- [What It Really Costs to Buy a Home (AB & BC, 2026)](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Home_Purchase_Cost_Guide_AB_BC_2026.pdf) (EN): Down payment, mortgage insurance, closing costs and first-time buyer programs in Alberta and BC, updated for 2026 — with a worked example on a $600,000 home and a cost worksheet.
- [What It Costs to Buy a Home (Korean, 2026)](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Home_Purchase_Cost_Guide_KO_2026.pdf) (한국어): Korean version of the home purchase cost guide: down payment, mortgage insurance, closing costs, first-time buyer programs and a cost worksheet.
- [Condo & Strata Red Flags Checklist](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Condo_Strata_Red_Flags_Checklist.pdf) (EN): The warning signs to look for in condo documents before you remove conditions, the documents to ask for, questions for the property manager, and your options if you find a problem.
- [Business Valuation: The Multiplier Explained](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Business_Valuation_Multiplier_Guide.pdf) (EN): How businesses are priced using SDE, EBITDA and revenue multiples. Typical ranges by business type, a full worked example, common mistakes and 14 questions every buyer should ask.
- [Commercial Lease Review: Key Points](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Commercial_Lease_Review_Guide.pdf) (EN): What to understand and negotiate before signing a commercial lease or Letter of Intent in Alberta or BC: rent and operating costs, renewal, assignment, personal guarantees and a tenant checklist.
- [Alberta Condo Document Review Guide (Korean)](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Alberta_Condo_Document_Guide_KO.pdf) (한국어): The 7 condo documents to review before removing conditions, the 7 red flags to watch for, and what to do if you find a problem. Written in Korean.
- [Calgary New Home Buying Guide (Korean)](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Calgary_New_Home_Buying_Guide_KO_2026.pdf) (한국어): An 8-step guide for first-time buyers purchasing a new home from a builder in Calgary: mortgage, the new GST rebate, builder checks, contracts, inspections and Alberta's new home warranty. Written in Korean.
- [Calgary Home Selling Guide (Korean)](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Calgary_Home_Selling_Guide_KO_2026.pdf) (한국어): Selling a house or condo in Calgary: the 10 steps, RPR and condo documents, selling costs, tax points (including the 365-day flipping rule) and a closing checklist. Written in Korean.
- [Asset Sale vs. Share Sale (AB & BC)](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Asset_vs_Share_Sale_Guide_AB_BC.pdf) (EN): How the deal structure changes tax, risk, licences and timing when you buy or sell a business — with 2026 tax rules, a BC PTT example and industry notes for gas stations, hotels and car washes.
- [Buying a Business: Offer to Closing Checklist](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Business_Purchase_Checklist_Alberta.pdf) (EN): A 5-stage checklist for buying a business in Alberta, plus extra checklists for gas stations, restaurants, liquor stores and motels.
- [Buying a Business Checklist (Korean)](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Business_Purchase_Checklist_KO.pdf) (한국어): Korean version of the 5-stage business purchase checklist, with extra checklists for gas stations, restaurants, liquor stores and motels.
- [Restaurant Equipment Due Diligence Checklist](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Restaurant_Equipment_Checklist_Calgary.pdf) (EN): A printable checklist for inspecting a restaurant, café or bar before you buy: cooking line, refrigeration, ventilation and fire safety, bar and POS, building systems and price allocation.
- [Mortgage Document Checklist (Residential & Commercial)](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Mortgage_Document_Checklist_AB_BC.pdf) (EN): Everything lenders ask for — for home buyers and for business and investment property buyers in Alberta and BC. Updated for 2026 rules.
- [Bridge Financing Explained](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Bridge_Financing_Guide_AB_BC.pdf) (EN): Buying your next home before your current home sale closes: how bridge financing works, costs, how to qualify, risks, alternatives and Alberta vs. BC differences.
- [Buying a Hotel or Motel: Step-by-Step](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Hotel_Purchase_Guide_AB_BC.pdf) (EN): A 10-phase guide for hotel and motel buyers in Alberta and BC: criteria, key numbers (RevPAR, ADR), LOI, purchase agreement, inspections, brand PIP, liquor licence, financing, closing and the first 90 days.
- [Buying a Grocery Store: Step-by-Step](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Grocery_Store_Purchase_Guide_AB_BC.pdf) (EN): For independent, banner and specialty / ethnic grocery stores: key numbers, the inventory clause, refrigeration checks, licences, financing, red flags and typical buyer costs.
- [Investment Property Guide: Rental Income, Numbers & Tax](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Investment_Property_Guide_AB_BC_2026.pdf) (EN): Key numbers (NOI, cap rate, cash flow), a worked Calgary rental example, financing rules, Alberta vs. BC differences, 2026 tax basics and a due diligence checklist.
- [Environmental Site Assessments (Phase I, II, III)](https://jasonchoirealestate.com/uploads/guides/Environmental_Site_Assessment_Guide.pdf) (EN): What each ESA phase does, when you need it, typical cost and time, and how environmental due diligence fits into buying commercial property — essential for gas stations and industrial sites.
